sources.entry: A human resources management system combines a number of systems and processes to ensure the easy management of human resources, business processes and data.

summary.name: Human resources (Wikipedia article)
summary.one_liner: Wikipedia article describing human resources as both the workforce of an organization and the HR department and practice of human resource management.
use_cases: understanding what an HR department does
researching history of human resource management
background on hiring abroad via an employer of record
reading about criticism of the term human resources
summary.what_it_does: This is an encyclopedia article, not a software tool. It defines human resources as the workforce of an organization and explains the HR department's role in hiring, performance management, payroll and benefits, and employee relations. It outlines the history of personnel administration and HR from the early 1900s onward, including the origins of the term "human resource." It also covers criticism of the terminology and describes Employer of Record (EOR) services for hiring employees in countries without local subsidiaries.
notable: Covers the history of HR from personnel administration (National Cash Register, 1900) onward
Explains the Employer of Record (EOR) model for international hiring
Discusses criticism of calling people 'resources' and alternative department names
caveats: Describes concepts and history only; it is not a software product
Some sources cited are dated or secondary; the article is general reference material
